mechanism.modeUse: Validate canonical raw root spelling, then canonicalize root/ancestors/issues/all path-bearing probes with measured mode. Native case_sensitive metadata must have exact pathless shape and agree with that mode.
mechanism.refusalScopeChanged: Only normalization of the existing strict ancestor-directory refusal scope; unknown issues and nonnegative bound operations still refuse.
mechanism.limitations: Captured observation checks only. No atomic live-capture or absence-of-all-OS-reads guarantee.
